notes: This dimension does NOT score understanding correctness (alias F1, missing-evidence accuracy, or indirect-mention refers/present rates).
Those concerns are covered by aliases / missing-evidence / indirect-mentions.

Long scripts amplify those failures; this dimension checks whether free deterministic paths stay bit-stable, discovery volume stays bounded, paid LLM budgets truncate as configured, and the pipeline does not crash.
LLM judgment bit-repeatability is explicitly out of scope (remote models are not deterministic). Budget + crash checks use a mock judge so the framework run stays free.
Protocol is a checklist of pass/fail probes, not precision/recall.
